cases.given: The surrounding artifact is large, but the actual defect is local and source-verifiable.
cases.expect: A proportional local correction with an explicit escalation condition.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: a governing workflow already fixes the required scale
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Risk-mandated review overrides the desire to stay at a cheaper scale.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible
the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A large artifact contains a narrow defect but might hide broader dependencies.
cases.expect: The skill chooses a local scale, states the signal for escalation, and returns from any global review to local execution.
cases.reject: The skill always applies maximum depth or treats scale names as decorative labels.
